title: चतुरधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Brahma says the ocean will be refilled in time through King Bhagiratha. Lomasha begins the story: King Sagara of Ayodhya, childless, worships Shiva and is granted sixty thousand sons by one queen and a single heir by the other.
summary.kn: ಕಾಲಾನಂತರ ಭಗೀರಥರಾಜನ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಮುದ್ರ ತುಂಬುವುದೆಂದು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಲೋಮಶರು ಕಥೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ: ಸಂತಾನಹೀನ ಅಯೋಧ್ಯೆಯ ಸಗರರಾಜನು ಶಿವನನ್ನು ಆರಾಧಿಸಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ರಾಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅರವತ್ತು ಸಾವಿರ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನೂ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರಿಯನ್ನೂ ಪಡೆಯುವ ವರ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: ब्रह्मा कहते हैं कि समय आने पर राजा भगीरथ के द्वारा समुद्र फिर भरेगा। लोमश कथा आरम्भ करते हैं: निःसन्तान अयोध्यापति सगर शिव की आराधना करते हैं और एक रानी से साठ हज़ार पुत्रों तथा दूसरी से एक उत्तराधिकारी का वर पाते हैं।
summary.te: కాలక్రమంలో భగీరథరాజు ద్వారా సముద్రం మళ్లీ నిండుతుందని బ్రహ్మ చెబుతాడు. లోమశుడు కథ ప్రారంభిస్తాడు: సంతానం లేని అయోధ్యరాజు సగరుడు శివుని ఆరాధించి ఒక రాణి యందు అరవై వేల మంది కుమారులను, మరొకరి యందు ఒక వారసుని పొందే వరం పొందుతాడు.
summary.ta: காலப்போக்கில் பகீரத மன்னன் மூலம் கடல் நிரம்பும் என்று ப்ரஹ்மா சொல்கிறார். லோமஶர் கதையைத் தொடங்குகிறார்: மக்கட்பேறற்ற அயோத்தி மன்னன் ஸகரன் ஶிவனை வழிபட்டு, ஓர் அரசியிடம் அறுபதாயிரம் மைந்தர்களையும் மற்றவளிடம் ஒரு வாரிசையும் பெறும் வரம் பெறுகிறான்.
summary.ml: സമുദ്രം കാലക്രമത്തിൽ ഭഗീരഥൻ രാജാവിലൂടെ വീണ്ടും നിറയുമെന്ന് ബ്രഹ്മാവ് പറയുന്നു. ലോമശൻ കഥ തുടങ്ങുന്നു: പുത്രനില്ലാത്ത അയോധ്യയിലെ സഗരരാജാവ് ശിവനെ ആരാധിക്കുന്നു; ഒരു രാജ്ഞിക്ക് അറുപതിനായിരം പുത്രന്മാരും മറ്റൊരാൾക്ക് ഒരു അവകാശിയും വരമായി ലഭിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.104; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
तानुवाच समेतांस्तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।
गच्छध्वं विबुधाः सर्वे यथाकामं यथेप्सितम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahma, grandfather of the worlds, said to them as they were assembled: "Go, gods, as you wish and please.

verses.text:
महता कालयोगेन प्रकृतिं यास्यतेऽर्णवः ।
ज्ञातीन्वै कारणं कृत्वा महाराज्ञो भगीरथात् ॥

meaning.en: "After a long time the ocean will return to its nature, through its kinsmen, as the cause, by the great king Bhagiratha."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कथं वै ज्ञातयो ब्रह्मन्कारणं चात्र किं मुने ।
कथं समुद्रः पूर्णश्च भगीरथपरिश्रमात् ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, how will kinsmen be the cause here, sage, and how will the ocean be filled through Bhagiratha's toil?

verses.text:
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण तपोधन ।
कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र राज्ञां चरितमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Ascetic, I wish to hear this fully, as you tell of the excellent life of those kings, learned one.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रेन्द्रो धर्मराज्ञा महात्मना ।
कथयामास माहात्म्यं सगरस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Asked so by the great-souled Yudhishthira, king of dharma, the foremost brahmin told of the greatness of the great Sagara.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातः सगरो नाम पार्थिवः ।
रूपसत्त्वबलोपेतः स चापुत्रः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: A king named Sagara was born in the Ikshvaku family, endowed with beauty, courage and strength, and mighty, but without a son.

verses.text:
स हैहयान्समुत्साद्य तालजङ्घांश्च भारत ।
वशे च कृत्वा राज्ञोऽन्यान्स्वराज्यमन्वशासत ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, having uprooted the Haihayas and Talajanghas and subdued other kings, he ruled his own kingdom.

verses.text:
तस्य भार्ये त्वभवतां रूपयौवनदर्पिते ।
वैदर्भी भरतश्रेष्ठ शैब्या च भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: He had two wives, proud of their beauty and youth: one from Vidarbha and one, Shaibya, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
स पुत्रकामो नृपतिस्तताप सुमहत्तपः ।
पत्नीभ्यां सह राजेन्द्र कैलासं गिरिमाश्रितः ॥

meaning.en: Wishing for a son, the king performed great austerity, king of kings, with his two wives, resorting to Mount Kailasa.

verses.text:
स तप्यमानः सुमहत्तपो योगसमन्वितः ।
आससाद महात्मानं त्र्यक्षं त्रिपुरमर्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: Practising great austerity and joined with yoga, he approached the great three-eyed god, destroyer of the Tripura cities.

verses.text:
शंकरं भवमीशानं शूलपानिं पिनाकिनम् ।
त्र्यम्बकं शिवमुग्रेशं बहुरूपमुमापतिम् ॥

meaning.en: He saw Shankara, Bhava, Ishana, the trident-bearer, the wielder of the Pinaka, Tryambaka, Shiva, the fierce lord, many-formed, husband of Uma.

verses.text:
स तं दृष्ट्वैव वरदं पत्नीभ्यां सहितो नृपः ।
प्रणिपत्य महाबाहुः पुत्रार्थं समयाचत ॥

meaning.en: As soon as he saw the boon-giver, the mighty-armed king with his two wives bowed and begged for sons.

verses.text:
तं प्रीतिमान्हरः प्राह सभार्यं नृपसत्तमम् ।
यस्मिन्वृतो मुहूर्तेऽहं त्वयेह नृपते वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Hara, pleased, said to that best of kings and his wives: "King, whichever moment I am asked for the boon by you here,

verses.text:
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि शूराः समरदर्पिताः ।
एकस्यां संभविष्यन्ति पत्न्यां तव नरोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: "sixty thousand sons, brave and proud in battle, will be born to you from one wife, best of men.

verses.text:
ते चैव सर्वे सहिताः क्षयं यास्यन्ति पार्थिव ।
एको वंशधरः शूर एकस्यां संभविष्यति ।
एवमुक्त्वा तु तं रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: "All of them together will meet destruction, king, and from the other wife one brave son will be born to carry on the line." Having said this, Rudra vanished there.

verses.text:
स चापि सगरो राजा जगाम स्वं निवेशनम् ।
पत्नीभ्यां सहितस्तात सोऽतिहृष्टमनास्तदा ॥

meaning.en: King Sagara went to his own house with his two wives, dear son, in great joy.

verses.text:
तस्याथ मनुजश्रेष्ठ ते भार्ये कमलेक्षणे ।
वैदर्भी चैव शैब्या च गर्भिण्यौ संबभूवतुः ॥

meaning.en: Then those two lotus-eyed wives, the Vidarbha princess and Shaibya, best of men, both became pregnant.

verses.text:
ततः कालेन वैदर्भी गर्भालाबुं व्यजायत ।
शैब्या च सुषुवे पुत्रं कुमारं देवरूपिणम् ॥

meaning.en: In time the Vidarbha princess gave birth to a gourd containing a foetus, and Shaibya bore a boy, a child like a god in form.

verses.text:
तदालाबुं समुत्स्रष्टुं मनश्चक्रे स पार्थिवः ।
अथान्तरिक्षाच्छुश्राव वाचं गम्भीरनिस्वनाम् ॥

meaning.en: The king made up his mind to throw the gourd away, but then he heard from the sky a deep voice.

verses.text:
राजन्मा साहसं कार्षीः पुत्रान्न त्यक्तुमर्हसि ।
अलाबुमध्यान्निष्कृष्य बीजं यत्नेन गोप्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: It said: "King, do not act rashly. You should not abandon your sons. Take the seeds out of the middle of the gourd and guard them carefully,

verses.text:
सोपस्वेदेषु पात्रेषु घृतपूर्णेषु भागशः ।
ततः पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिं प्राप्स्यसि पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: "in warmed vessels filled with ghee, one part to each. Then you will get sixty thousand sons, king.

verses.text:
महादेवेन दिष्टं ते पुत्रजन्म नराधिप ।
अनेन क्रमयोगेन मा ते बुद्धिरतोऽन्यथा ॥

meaning.en: "The birth of sons has been decreed for you by Mahadeva, lord of men. Let your mind not change from this method."
